title: Synchronize arm action with a staggered two-foot forward push.
brief: The priority is gathering a split starting base into a parallel landing while the arms match leg extension. Elevated landing, one-arm forward release, fore-aft ankle reversal, a switched split landing and a small integrated vertical jump give distinct coordination jobs without returning to Class 1's drill.

explosive.name: Split-Stance Broad Jump to Parallel Landing
explosive.job: Convert a staggered bilateral push into aligned forward travel.
explosive.cue: Begin with one foot modestly ahead, dip once and swing both arms; push off both feet and gather into a parallel two-foot landing held 2 s.
explosive.regress: Reduce stagger and travel; stop if it becomes a single-leg jump or the landing twists.

explosive.name: Countermovement Broad Jump onto a Low Box
explosive.job: Time the forward arm drive while receiving the body on a higher surface.
explosive.cue: Use a stationary two-foot dip and forward/up arm swing to land both feet fully on a low stable box; stand, then step down under control.
explosive.regress: Use lower/closer placement; stop for excessive knee tucking, partial-foot landing or an unstable box.
explosive.gate: Full-foot low-box landing and controlled step-down.

explosive.name: Single-arm Forward Medicine Ball Push Throw
explosive.job: Couple one arm's forward force with a bilateral leg drive while resisting unwanted rotation.
explosive.cue: Use a very light ball at one shoulder, feet parallel; dip and extend into a forward push release while keeping hips facing the target and feet planted.
explosive.regress: Reduce load; stop if trunk rotation or an arm-only strain replaces the coordinated push.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support

explosive.name: Two-foot Forward–Backward Line Pogo
explosive.job: Reverse small fore-aft ankle contacts while maintaining an organized trunk.
explosive.cue: Make six low two-foot crossings of a flat floor line, alternating forward/backward; each crossing is one landing, then settle.
explosive.regress: Narrow the crossing distance; stop for deep squatting or loss of rhythm.

explosive.name: Lunge Switch Jump
explosive.job: Reorganize an asymmetrical base in flight without a long forward bound.
explosive.cue: From a shallow split stance, jump modestly and switch legs in flight; hold the opposite split landing 2 s. Reset the stated starting side before each rep.
explosive.regress: Reduce height and stance length; stop if the feet cross or the landing cannot be held.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump — Natural Arms
explosive.job: Integrate dip-to-arm timing with a small vertical flight before fatigue accumulates in lifting.
explosive.cue: Dip once, drive the arms up with leg extension, land in the starting area on two feet and hold 2 s.
explosive.regress: Use modest height; stop if the arms finish after takeoff or landing control fails.

control.name: Dead Bug Isometric Hand-to-Thigh Press
control.job: Lightly brace the trunk against arm/leg force so the takeoff push is not accompanied by lumbar arching.
control.cue: Lie supine, one hip/knee bent; press the opposite palm and thigh gently together while keeping ribs down and breathing.
control.regress: Lower the limb lever/pressure; stop for breath-holding or back arching.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

control.name: Big Toe Press Iso Hold
control.job: Maintain the big-toe contact used to direct the final foot push.
control.cue: Keep the foot flat and long toes; press the big toe gently down without curling it or lifting the other contact points.
control.regress: Reduce pressure; stop if the arch collapses or the toes claw.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

strength.name: Hip Thrust — pelvic dumbbell, upper back on bench
Bent-Knee Soleus Raise — seated, dumbbells on thighs

decision: This is a bilateral coordination emphasis after the single-support class, not a harder contact day. The low-box jump changes the landing elevation and full-foot placement task; it is not presented as a different distance target for the ordinary broad jump. The switched split landing differs from Class 2's same-stance landing. Split-squat volume returns to one set per side and squat to three bilateral sets; no load increase is earned from written work.
next_job: Class 5 will emphasize hip-led projection and rapid hip impulse; review actual arm/landing timing and lower-body recovery first.
